title: Schindler's List 20th Anniversary Limited Edition (DVD) Moorpark Library
descriptionText:
2 DVDs - purchased at a yard sale. Tested and works fine. No scratches.

Celebrate the 20th anniversary of the iconic war film "Schindler's List" with this limited edition DVD from the Moorpark Library. Directed by Steven Spielberg and produced by a talented team including Branko Lustig, Carla Shelley, Gerald R. Molen, Jerry Molen, and Steven Spielberg, this movie tells the story of Oskar Schindler, a German businessman who saved the lives of over 1,000 Jewish people during World War II. 

The DVD features the movie in English, French, and Spanish with a rating of R and a sub-genre of biography. It also includes special features such as documentaries, behind-the-scenes footage, and interviews with the cast and crew. This is a must-have for any film collector or history enthusiast.
